scope: M4.1 read-only ticket lookup with pre-gateway authorization

omitted_axes.reason: M4.1 is a read-only single-request slice; repeatability and zero-call denial are covered without shared write state.
M4.1 exposes an HTTP/application API and has no UI surface.

test_cases.requirement: Static typed ticket_lookup capability and allowlisted result
test_cases.risk: Dynamic/plugin behavior or provider fields escape the boundary.
prerequisites: Static registry and typed fake gateway are available.
steps: Resolve ticket_lookup and execute one authorized fake lookup.
expected_results: One versioned static descriptor resolves; unknown capability fails; public result contains only opaque reference, title, status and summary.
evidence_to_capture: Focused pytest result and serialized response field inventory.

test_cases.risk: Unauthorized or cross-Workspace callers leak external existence or invoke the provider.
prerequisites: Counting fake gateway and two Workspace principals exist.
steps: Run unauthorized, cross-Workspace, missing-binding and scope-mismatch lookups.
expected_results: Every case fails closed with the safe authorization outcome and gateway invocation count remains zero.
evidence_to_capture: Denial matrix, HTTP codes/error codes and gateway call-count assertion.

test_cases.requirement: m4r1 reference integrity, key lifecycle and trusted-store binding
test_cases.risk: Caller-forged or stale references reveal a provider resource.
prerequisites: Deterministic key ring and trusted reference store fixtures exist.
steps: Verify valid active/retiring references; mutate MAC/claims; exercise expired, unknown-key, revoked-key and missing/mismatched store records.
expected_results: Only exact active/retiring references resolve; every mutation fails before resource authorization/gateway and exposes no raw provider ID.
evidence_to_capture: Named mutation matrix and zero-call assertions.

test_cases.requirement: Workspace-scoped HTTP contract and safe result mapping
test_cases.risk: Request extras, unsafe status mapping or field leakage make the public contract ambiguous.
prerequisites: HTTP test client and trusted authentication fixtures exist.
steps: Call the route for authenticated success, missing auth, cross-Workspace, malformed/schema-extra reference and authorized missing ticket.
expected_results: Responses match the locked 200/401/403/400/422/404 envelopes and success is allowlisted.
evidence_to_capture: Sanitized request/response matrix and schema field inventory.

test_cases.requirement: Typed provider errors remain distinct and non-leaking
test_cases.risk: Provider denial/unavailability/contract-invalid is confused with authorized not-found or success.
prerequisites: Fake gateway can return each closed provider outcome.
steps: Return scope denial, unavailability, contract-invalid and authorized not-found from the gateway boundary.
expected_results: Each typed outcome maps deterministically; no internal exception, raw ID or SDK object appears.
evidence_to_capture: Outcome-to-HTTP mapping table and sanitized response bodies.

test_cases.requirement: SQLite reference-provider read contract is independent and restart-safe
test_cases.risk: Fake-only evidence or shared Knora state fails to prove the external boundary.
prerequisites: Temporary SQLite path and provider seed are available.
steps: Seed scoped ticket data, perform authorized lookup, recreate the adapter using the same file, repeat lookup and attempt a different scope.
expected_results: Authorized data survives adapter restart; wrong scope is denied; no ToolActionStore/PostgreSQL state is used.
evidence_to_capture: SQLite path identity, before/after results and dependency/call-path assertion.

test_cases.requirement: No write authority and no M1-M3 regression
test_cases.risk: The read slice gains provider write behavior or changes existing product behavior.
prerequisites: Docker services and clean migrated database are available.
steps: Run focused M4.1 tests, full pytest, Ruff, Compose config and clean-database Alembic upgrade; inspect changed scope.
expected_results: All verification is green; no provider write/approval/execution path exists in the slice.
evidence_to_capture: Command summaries, migration result, diff inventory and clean status.
